note: Miss Chan already provided highlight_sample and highlight_advanced for all 105 Oxford 6B drafts. The studio DB currently stores only one `highlight` column, so one-sided highlights happen when the two phrases differ (not merely by case). Do not rewrite example sentences. Use these as test cases.

cards.sample_en: We pick up rubbish in the park.
cards.advanced_en: After the picnic, the children pick up rubbish so that the beach stays clean.

cards.sample_en: We recycle paper, plastic bottles and cans at school.
cards.advanced_en: Because the bins are clearly labelled, pupils recycle paper, plastic bottles and cans every Friday.
cards.highlight_sample: recycle paper, plastic bottles and cans
cards.highlight_advanced: recycle paper, plastic bottles and cans

cards.sample_en: Mum reuses plastic bags for shopping.
cards.advanced_en: Although the shop offers new bags, Mum reuses plastic bags from home so that less plastic is wasted.

cards.sample_en: Please turn the air conditioner down at night.
cards.advanced_en: If the room is only a little warm, we turn the air conditioner down to save electricity.

cards.sample_en: Please turn the lights off after class.
cards.advanced_en: Now that the music lesson has ended, May turns the lights off before she goes home.

cards.sample_en: We use energy-efficient bulbs in our flat.
cards.advanced_en: After the old bulbs burn out, Dad will use energy-efficient bulbs so that the lights use less power.

cards.sample_en: We use rechargeable batteries in the remote control.
cards.advanced_en: We use rechargeable batteries in the camera and the toys, as they can be used many times.

cards.sample_en: We use up leftovers at lunch the next day.
cards.advanced_en: Although the rice is from last night, Mum heats it and we use up leftovers instead of wasting food.

cards.sample_en: Tom has long showers every morning.
cards.advanced_en: If Tom has long showers before school, the family uses much more water than they need.

cards.sample_en: Do not leave the taps on while you brush your teeth.
cards.advanced_en: While Amy washes the dishes, she must not leave the taps on, or water will run into the sink unused.

cards.sample_en: They throw away leftovers after dinner.
cards.advanced_en: Because they cook too much rice, they throw away leftovers instead of keeping them for lunch.

cards.sample_en: Some people throw away paper, plastic bottles and cans.
cards.advanced_en: If there is no recycling bin nearby, some pupils throw away paper, plastic bottles and cans in the ordinary bin.
cards.highlight_sample: throw away paper, plastic bottles and cans
cards.highlight_advanced: throw away paper, plastic bottles and cans

cards.sample_en: They use disposable batteries in the torch.
cards.advanced_en: Although rechargeable batteries last longer, they still use disposable batteries and then throw them out.

cards.sample_en: The stall uses foam containers for takeaway noodles.
cards.advanced_en: Because foam is hard to recycle, we should not use foam containers for our takeaway lunch.

cards.sample_en: We use paper fans on hot days.
cards.advanced_en: If the afternoon is only a little warm, we use paper fans instead of turning on the air conditioner.

cards.sample_en: Please unplug appliances after you use them.
cards.advanced_en: Before the family goes on holiday, Dad unplugs appliances so that they do not waste electricity.

cards.sample_en: Please turn off the lights before you leave.
cards.advanced_en: After the charity sale, we throw the torn shirts away because they cannot be sold.

cards.sample_en: The plants will die unless we water them every day.
cards.advanced_en: Unless the rain stops before lunch, the sports day will be moved indoors.

cards.sample_en: An Asian elephant uses its trunk to pick up food.
cards.advanced_en: Although an Asian elephant is huge, it can move quietly through the forest to find leaves.

cards.sample_en: A cheetah can run faster than any other land animal.
cards.advanced_en: Because a cheetah depends on speed to catch its food, it cannot live well if the grassland is destroyed.

cards.sample_en: An otter swims in the river and looks for fish.
cards.advanced_en: While an otter dives in the river, it looks for fish and frogs among the stones.

cards.sample_en: A polar bear lives on the sea ice in the Arctic.
cards.advanced_en: If the sea ice melts too quickly, a polar bear must swim farther to hunt for seals.

cards.sample_en: Visitors take photos of a rhino at the safari park.
cards.advanced_en: Because people still hunt rhinos for their horns, a rhino is now very rare in the wild.

cards.sample_en: A Siberian tiger has thick fur to stay warm.
cards.advanced_en: After the snow covers the forest, a Siberian tiger walks quietly among the trees to hunt.

cards.sample_en: People destroy forests to build more roads.
cards.advanced_en: If people destroy forests for farms and roads, many animals will lose their homes.

cards.sample_en: Some people eat shark fin soup at wedding dinners.
cards.advanced_en: Although the soup is served at some banquets, we should not eat shark fin soup because sharks are in danger.

cards.sample_en: Some hunters hunt for ivory tusks and sell them.
cards.advanced_en: Because some people still hunt for ivory tusks, many elephants are now in danger.

cards.sample_en: Some people wear fur coats in winter.
cards.advanced_en: If more shoppers wear fur coats, more wild animals may be killed for their skins.

cards.sample_en: A blue whale is the largest animal in the sea.
cards.advanced_en: Although a blue whale is enormous, it feeds mainly on tiny animals in the ocean.

cards.sample_en: A dolphin jumps out of the water near the boat.
cards.advanced_en: While the boat moves slowly, a dolphin swims beside it and clicks to call its group.

cards.sample_en: A giant panda eats bamboo in the forest.
cards.advanced_en: Because a giant panda needs a lot of bamboo each day, it cannot survive if the forest is cut down.

cards.sample_en: A reef fish hides among the colourful coral.
cards.advanced_en: If the coral loses its colour, a reef fish may have nowhere safe to hide from bigger fish.

cards.sample_en: A shark has sharp teeth and a strong tail.
cards.advanced_en: Although a shark looks frightening, it is an important hunter that keeps the ocean in balance.

cards.sample_en: The classroom is cleaned after school.
cards.advanced_en: Because people want more farmland, many forests are destroyed each year.

cards.sample_en: Since the bus is late, we wait in the shelter.
cards.advanced_en: Since the forest is getting smaller, the pandas have less bamboo to eat.

cards.sample_en: The bag is very heavy. Therefore, Tom asks for help.
cards.advanced_en: The road is blocked after the storm. Therefore, the pupils walk to school along a quieter street.

cards.sample_en: Tom has a cold and feels tired.
cards.advanced_en: Because Tom has a cold, he stays at home and does not go to football practice.

cards.sample_en: Lily has a cough after the long run.
cards.advanced_en: Although Lily drinks warm tea, she still has a cough at night and cannot sleep well.

cards.sample_en: Ben has a fever and feels very hot.
cards.advanced_en: If Ben has a fever in the morning, Mum will take him to the clinic after breakfast.

cards.sample_en: May has a headache and sits quietly.
cards.advanced_en: After May reads for too long, she has a headache and has to rest her eyes.

cards.sample_en: Sam has a runny nose in the morning.
cards.advanced_en: While Sam sits in the waiting room, he has a runny nose and keeps reaching for tissues.

cards.sample_en: Amy has a sore throat and speaks softly.
cards.advanced_en: Because Amy has a sore throat, the teacher lets her drink water during the lesson.

cards.sample_en: Tom has a stomach ache after lunch.
cards.advanced_en: If Tom has a stomach ache again, he should stop eating snacks and tell the nurse.

cards.sample_en: Ben has a toothache and cannot chew well.
cards.advanced_en: Although Ben tries to eat slowly, he still has a toothache and needs to see the dentist.

cards.sample_en: The doctor tells me to drink plenty of water.
cards.advanced_en: After you take the medicine, you should drink plenty of water so that you can get better sooner.

cards.sample_en: You should stay in bed and rest today.
cards.advanced_en: Because May still has a high temperature, the doctor says she must stay in bed until she feels stronger.

cards.sample_en: Remember to take medicine after meals.
cards.advanced_en: If the label says three times a day, Tom must take medicine in the morning, after lunch and at night.

cards.sample_en: Please wear a mask on the bus if you are ill.
cards.advanced_en: Although the clinic is not crowded, Amy still chooses to wear a mask so that others stay safe.

cards.sample_en: Dad has a backache after moving the boxes.
cards.advanced_en: Dad sits on a firm chair and does not lift anything heavy, as he has a backache.

cards.sample_en: Several pupils have the flu this week.
cards.advanced_en: After two classmates catch the flu, the teacher reminds everyone to wash their hands often.

cards.sample_en: Tom has to have an injection at the clinic.
cards.advanced_en: Although Tom is nervous, he sits still and has an injection without crying.

cards.sample_en: You should stay away from crowded places this week.
cards.advanced_en: If you have the flu, stay away from crowded places so that the illness does not spread.

cards.sample_en: Why is May at home today? She has a cold.
cards.advanced_en: How often does Tom visit the dentist? He visits the dentist twice a year.

cards.sample_en: Mum asked me to put on my jacket.
cards.advanced_en: The nurse told Tom not to take off his mask in the clinic.

cards.sample_en: Sam has a broken arm and wears a cast.
cards.advanced_en: After Sam falls from the wall bars, he has a broken arm and cannot write with his right hand.

cards.sample_en: Lily has a broken leg and uses crutches.
cards.advanced_en: Because Lily has a broken leg, her friends carry her school bag up the stairs for her.

cards.sample_en: Tom has a bruise on his knee.
cards.advanced_en: After the football match, Tom has a bruise on his leg, but he can still walk home.

cards.sample_en: May has a burn on her finger.
cards.advanced_en: While May is taking the pan off the stove, she gets a burn on her hand and runs it under cold water.

cards.sample_en: Ben has a cut on his thumb.
cards.advanced_en: If the knife slips, you may get a cut, so you should ask an adult to help.

cards.sample_en: Amy has a twisted ankle after PE.
cards.advanced_en: Because Amy has a twisted ankle, she sits out of the race and puts some ice on it.

cards.sample_en: Tom has a sting on his arm from a bee.
cards.advanced_en: After a wasp lands on the drink, Lily gets a sting on her finger and asks the teacher for help.

cards.sample_en: The nurse puts a bandage on his wrist.
cards.advanced_en: The cut is quite long, so the nurse wraps a bandage around his arm after cleaning it.

cards.sample_en: She cleans the cut with a cotton wool ball.
cards.advanced_en: Before she puts on the plaster, she presses a cotton wool ball gently on the cut to dry it.

cards.sample_en: Mum puts a plaster on my finger.
cards.advanced_en: If the small cut is still open, put a plaster on it so that dirt cannot get in.

cards.sample_en: Use the scissors to cut the tape.
cards.advanced_en: After the nurse finds the scissors, she cuts the bandage to the right length.

cards.sample_en: He has a blister on his heel.
cards.advanced_en: Because his new shoes are too tight, he has a blister on his heel after the long walk.

cards.sample_en: Never touch a broken wire, or you may get an electric shock.
cards.advanced_en: Because the wire is damaged, Ben must not touch it, or he may get an electric shock.

cards.sample_en: Ben has a nosebleed after the match.
cards.advanced_en: While Ben leans forward, Mum asks him to pinch his nose until the nosebleed stops.

cards.sample_en: Tom has a swollen knee after he falls.
cards.advanced_en: After he bumps into the bench, Tom has a swollen knee and cannot bend it easily.

cards.sample_en: Tom needs another pencil for the test.
cards.advanced_en: Because the first plaster came off, May asked for another plaster after PE.

cards.sample_en: The other children wait in the hall.
cards.advanced_en: After Ben finishes his turn, he helps the other players pack the balls away.

cards.sample_en: Ben cut himself while he was making a sandwich.
cards.advanced_en: After the hike, the children packed the tents themselves so that the teacher could rest.

cards.en: give your seats to people in need
cards.sample_en: Please give your seats to people in need.
cards.advanced_en: If elderly passengers get on the MTR, you should give your seats to people in need at once.
cards.highlight_sample: give your seats to people in need
cards.highlight_advanced: give your seats to people in need

cards.sample_en: Please hold the handrail on the bus.
cards.advanced_en: Because the tram starts suddenly, you should hold the handrail so that you do not fall.

cards.sample_en: We let passengers exit first before we get on.
cards.advanced_en: Although the crowd is in a hurry, we still let passengers exit first at the MTR door.

cards.sample_en: We queue up at the bus stop.
cards.advanced_en: After the first bus leaves, the children queue up quietly so that everyone can get on fairly.

cards.sample_en: Do not block the doors of the train.
cards.advanced_en: If you stand too close and block the doors, other passengers cannot get off the MTR in time.

cards.sample_en: Please do not disturb others with loud music.
cards.advanced_en: Because many passengers are reading or resting, you should not disturb others by talking loudly on the phone.

cards.sample_en: It is rude to jump the queue at the stop.
cards.advanced_en: If someone tries to jump the queue, the other pupils should remind him to wait his turn.

cards.sample_en: Do not lean against the grab poles in the carriage.
cards.advanced_en: Although you may feel tired, you should not lean against the grab poles, because other passengers need to hold them.

cards.en: put your feet on the seats
cards.sample_en: Do not put your feet on the seats.
cards.advanced_en: Even if you are tired after school, you must not put your feet on the seats and make them dirty.
cards.highlight_sample: put your feet on the seats
cards.highlight_advanced: put your feet on the seats

cards.sample_en: Do not take up extra seats with your bags.
cards.advanced_en: Because the bus is crowded after school, you should not take up extra seats and leave no room for others.

cards.sample_en: Amy wants to sit near the window.
cards.advanced_en: Although the bus is packed, Lily refuses to sit while an elderly man is standing.

cards.sample_en: Mum lets Ben choose a seat.
cards.advanced_en: While we stand at the stop, we watch the children board the bus one by one.

cards.sample_en: We ought to speak quietly on the bus.
cards.advanced_en: Because elderly passengers are standing, we ought not to sit across two seats.

cards.sample_en: We do archery at the camp in the morning.
cards.advanced_en: After the instructor checks the bows, the pupils do archery on the field behind the tents.

cards.sample_en: They go canoeing on the quiet lake.
cards.advanced_en: If the water is calm after breakfast, we will go canoeing along the side of the lake.

cards.sample_en: Dad and I go fishing by the river.
cards.advanced_en: Although the sky looks grey, Dad and I still go fishing by the river and wait for a small fish to bite.

cards.sample_en: The team will go orienteering in the country park.
cards.advanced_en: With a map and a compass in each group, they go orienteering through the hills before lunch.

cards.sample_en: We go rock climbing with safety ropes.
cards.advanced_en: After they put on helmets, the pupils go rock climbing on the low wall beside the camp.

cards.sample_en: They go sailing on the wide harbour.
cards.advanced_en: If the wind is steady and not too strong, the class will go sailing with the instructor.

cards.sample_en: We go stargazing on the hill at night.
cards.advanced_en: There are few city lights near the camp, so we go stargazing and look for the bright planets.

cards.sample_en: Sam wants to go windsurfing at the beach.
cards.advanced_en: While the waves stay small, Sam can go windsurfing and practise turning the sail.

cards.sample_en: The children go zorbing down the gentle slope.
cards.advanced_en: After they climb inside the huge plastic balls, they go zorbing down the hill and shout with laughter.

cards.sample_en: Ben and Tom play air hockey in the games room.
cards.advanced_en: Because it starts to rain, the boys play air hockey indoors until the sky clears.

cards.sample_en: The two teams play tug of war on the grass.
cards.advanced_en: Although one team is smaller, they still play tug of war and pull together at the same time.

cards.sample_en: We sing around the campfire in the evening.
cards.advanced_en: After dinner, the pupils sing around the campfire so that everyone can join in the last song of the day.

cards.sample_en: We go birdwatching near the wetland.
cards.advanced_en: If we walk quietly along the path, we can go birdwatching and see egrets in the trees.

cards.sample_en: They go bowling at the sports centre after camp.
cards.advanced_en: Because the lake activities are full, some pupils go bowling at the nearby sports centre instead.

cards.sample_en: We go kayaking in the narrow river.
cards.advanced_en: After the instructor shows them how to hold the paddle, they go kayaking in pairs along the river.

cards.sample_en: Dad and I play snooker on the green table.
cards.advanced_en: While they wait for the rain to stop, the boys play snooker and take turns aiming at the coloured balls.

cards.sample_en: May and Lily play squash after school.
cards.advanced_en: Although the court is small and the ball is fast, May still loves to play squash with Lily.

cards.sample_en: I would rather go fishing than stay in the tent.
cards.advanced_en: Although the games room is open, Tom would rather go rock climbing than play air hockey.
cards.highlight_sample: would rather go fishing than stay
cards.highlight_advanced: would rather go rock climbing than play

cards.sample_en: You can either sit by the window or sit near the door.
cards.advanced_en: If it rains after lunch, we will either play air hockey or sing around the campfire.
cards.highlight_sample: either sit by the window or sit near the door
cards.highlight_advanced: either play air hockey or sing around the campfire

cards.sample_en: We can neither go canoeing nor go sailing today.
cards.advanced_en: Because the wind is too strong, the pupils can neither go windsurfing nor go kayaking until the lake is calmer.
cards.highlight_sample: neither go canoeing nor go sailing
cards.highlight_advanced: neither go windsurfing nor go kayaking
